header: Sub CPU: enemy movement, formation and sprite bookkeeping. It shares
$0000-$1FFF with the main CPU but has no access to sound or I/O. Its
foreground runs the same kind of per-mode task lists as the main CPU
(game_mode $102F, task index $107A); its IRQ copies its sprites into
sprite RAM and meets the main CPU's IRQ at frame_sync ($10AF).

E000.name: reset_sub
doc: Sub CPU reset (released by the main CPU's SRESET_OFF write).
DP = $10, S = $1D80; wait for $11 in $0800 from the main CPU;
checksum $A000-$BFFF, $C000-$DFFF, $E000-$FFFF (byte sums must be
0; failures leave '6', '5', '4' in $0801, shown by the service
mode); answer $22 in $0800; 256 times write $6001 (IRQ on) and
$500F (unmapped in MAME; meaning unknown); enable interrupts and
enter the task scheduler.

E061.name: irq_sub
doc: Sub CPU vblank IRQ.
- acknowledge (even VINTON address = IRQ off);
- copy the sub's sprites from the shadow buffers ($0E00-$0EE1 +
banks $1600/$1E00; bit 7 of the flag byte = in use) into sprite
RAM from slot 1 ($0F82) up to slot 39, mirrored when the screen
is flipped; unused slots get Y/flags $F000 (parked off-screen);
- frame_sync = $11 and wait for the main CPU's IRQ to answer $22
(the two IRQ handlers meet here every frame);
- IRQ on (odd VINTON address), RTI.

E0EC.name: task_dispatch_sub
doc: The sub CPU's scheduler: jump through
sub_mode_task_lists[game_mode][sub_task]. Tasks end with
INC <$7A / JMP task_dispatch_sub; the last one
(task_end_frame_sub) waits for the IRQ and restarts the list.

E0F9.name: sub_mode_task_lists
doc: One task list per game mode 0-9 (pointers).

E13F.name: sub_tasks_mode5
doc: Mode 5: normal play (the longest list).

E16B.name: sub_tasks_mode6
doc: Mode 6: stage clear.

E171.name: sub_tasks_mode7
doc: Mode 7: challenging stage.

E17F.name: task_end_frame_sub
doc: Last task of every list: CWAI for the next IRQ, reset the stack,
restart the list.

E18A.name: task_stage_setup
doc: Mode 2 task: build the stage's enemy sprites and formation state
from the stage tables (index $106E), then game_mode + 1.
QUIRK: stage tables indexed with a signed A,X offset from $106E * 2: values above 2 read further into the ROM.

BF58.name: task_formation_init
doc: Mode 0 task: mark all 44 formation slots occupied and load the
formation pointers.

B90E.name: task_animate_objects
doc: Run the state machines of the four objects in $111D-$1120
(sprites $0EE2, $0EEC, $0EF6, $0F00) through object_states.

B930.name: object_state_call
doc: Jump to object_states[A]: ASLA / LDX #object_states / JMP [A,X] (8-bit shift, signed offset). In: A state, U sprite entry, Y state byte.

B936.name: object_spawn_random
doc: Object state 1: place the object at a pseudo-random position. The sub has no RNG: Y is the byte at $E000 + (signed) frame_counter, i.e. its own reset code for $00-$7F and $DF80-$DFFF (fill, checksum) for $80-$FF, clamped to $20-$CF (below $20 -> $90, $D0 and up -> $60); X = frame_counter | $B0.

E51C.name: scan_formation
doc: For each formation entry with bit 4: copy its slot position ($1B00+2n) to $1630+2n and step its sprite code $18F0+n through dat_E591; reaching 0 clears the entry and its sprite.

BFEF.name: checksum_A000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $A000-$BFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

DFEF.name: checksum_C000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $C000-$DFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

FFEF.name: checksum_E000
doc: Checksum adjust: the byte sum of $E000-$FFFF is 0 (tested at
boot or in the service mode).

B014.name: task_formation_move
doc: Formation mover task: for every slot with b1 in formation_flags,
point the slot pointers $1084-$10CB at its data, set its sprite
up on the first visit (b7), then step its path ($B0D4) or home in
on its formation position ($B242). Rewinds formation_ptr at $188D.
QUIRK: unbounded scan: from a formation_ptr past the table it wraps through the address space (the Round Advance corruption).

B0D4.name: formation_path_step
doc: Step a slot along its path: counter [$1090] minus speed [$10AD];
at 0 the path pointer advances: $F0 end, $FF/$FE new heading +
jump, else a heading.

B163.name: formation_move_sprite
doc: Move by <$98 units along heading A (heading_table + 4*A: dy, dx, bits).
QUIRK: headings are not range-checked ($B173).

B20D.name: formation_set_picture
doc: Picture from byte 3 of heading entry X: low nibble into [$1084], whole byte to [$10CB], bits 4-5 = flip bits of [$10A4].

B242.name: formation_home
doc: Turn towards the formation position (octant tables home_octants_a-d) or arrive within 4 units.

B385.name: task_attack_timer
doc: Mode 5: unless $10D6, every 64th frame step $1129 (max $1F); its range picks a count from stage_params ($1036-$1039); enough moving slots -> $112A = $55 (formation attacks allowed), else 0.
QUIRK: unbounded scan from formation_ptr, as task_formation_move.

B3D1.name: task_effect
doc: Mode 5: when $10CF is set, $101A = $FF and run power-up effect handler tbl_B3E6[$1070] (A = 2 * effect, signed JMP [A,X]).

B461.name: effect_animate
doc: Animate the six effect sprites $0E92-$0E9D: on even frames six code/colour words from dat_B483, frame (frame_counter & $0C) / 4.

BB50.name: task_launch_objects
doc: Mode 5: while $1122, every $2D frames start the next object of dat_BB8E (state 1) if idle; count $1123 once all are out.

BB96.name: task_challenge_seq
doc: Mode 7 challenging-stage sequencer, stepped by challenge_step: set-up, 22 animation frames of dat_F0C1, pick the wave size (dat_BCB4/BCC0), release one bonus object every 8 frames. CWAIs once.
QUIRK: step $17 searches dat_BCB4 for the stage with no end marker; a stage not in the list runs on through memory.

BCF3.name: task_bonus_objects
doc: Mode 7: run the handler of every bonus object with a non-zero bonus_state ($1132-$1136) with X = its bonus_free flag and U = its sprite entry ($0E30+2k).

BD18.name: bonus_state_call
doc: Jump to tbl_BEDD[state - 1] (DECA / ASLA / JMP [A,Y], signed).

BEE5.name: task_bonus_colours
doc: Mode 7: for each non-zero entry of $114A-$1158 sprite $0E30+2k gets code dat_BF27[$115E] and flags dat_BF40[$115E]; $115E steps and wraps at the 0 terminator.

doc: Path stream: 230 headings (heading_table indexes),
then FF = jump to $A44B.
Stepped by formation_path_step ($B0D4) via [$108C]; see docs/modules/sub-C.md.

E341.name: task_formation_anim
doc: Formation tiles; dispatch on frame_counter & 7 (tbl_E359).

E369.name: formation_sprite_codes
doc: This frame's formation sprite codes into $0E02-$0E2F.
QUIRK: stage tables indexed with a signed A,X offset from $106E * 2.

E3DA.name: formation_move
doc: Step the formation along its path ($1082), lay out $1602-$1631.

E4B5.name: formation_scan_next
doc: JSR scan_formation, then the next task.

E4BD.name: formation_slots_1B00
doc: Formation slot positions at $1B00-$1B5F.

E654.name: task_capture_steer
doc: Capture, capture_state 1: animate $0E8A from dat_E6F9 (capture_anim_idx), move the player towards $168A and the beam sprite towards X - 5.
QUIRK: $E6EF discards the SUBB (LDD / SUBB / STA).

E7ED.name: task_capture_dispatch
doc: Capture sub-state machine: JMP through tbl_E7F5[capture_substate].

E8D7.name: capture_collect
doc: Capture sub-state 1: each caught slot (b6) is copied to the next of the six captured-ship sprites $0EC2-$0ECD; capture_substate += 2.

E934.name: capture_home_y
doc: Capture sub-state 3: move each captured sprite one step towards the player's Y + offset; when none moved, next sub-state.

E9E8.name: capture_leave_x
doc: Capture sub-state 4: move the captured sprites in X to the player's X; when none moved clear the capture state, dual_fighter = 1 if one of the first five is in use.
QUIRK: DECB before the test ($EA3E): 5 of 6 entries tested.

EA4C.name: task_formation_refill
doc: On even frames while a refill is due fly a sprite in (dat_EB2C paths, dat_F0C1 frames); at step $18 put an enemy into the first empty formation slot from frame_counter & $3F mod $27.
QUIRK: with no free formation slot the search at $EB29 loops forever.

EBEC.name: task_escort_flyin_a
doc: Mode 3: step counter $1116: sprite $0F1E start position, animation from dat_F0C1, then place the wing sprites from the stage tables one every 5 frames; CWAI at $ED16, then game_mode + 1.

F116.name: task_escort_flyin_b
doc: Mode 3: the $0F20-slot twin of task_escort_flyin_a's first steps, reading $1116-$1118 without changing them.
QUIRK: never advances $1116-$1118 (task_escort_flyin_a does).

F0ED.name: reset_formation_rows
doc: Fill $18C0-$18EB and $19E0-$1A0B (interleaved) with <$10; path pointers $184C-$1853 = $C0E9, $1854-$1857 = $C000.

F5A5.name: task_stage_entry_seq
doc: Mode 4: step seq_step: two sprites at $0F1E/$0F20 animated through dat_F0C1 until its $0000 word; CWAI at $F5FE, clear frame_counter, game_mode + 1.

F60B.name: task_bonus_sequence
doc: Mode 5: when the score parity changes (score_parity) start the same sprite sequence; later steps go through tbl_F62B (bonus sprite drops into place, extra life).
QUIRK: 8-bit ASLA ($F621): steps from $1C jump through data past tbl_F62B.

F844.name: task_enemy_shots
doc: Modes 3-5: the first formation member diving at Y $A0 or $C0 fires once (shot_fired_flags): a shot sprite in a free slot of $0ECE..[$1064] with shot_velocity.
QUIRK: the free-slot search stops only on an exact match with $1064 ($F8A6).

F8C9.name: shot_velocity
doc: Shot speed word into [$0C92,U]: B = min((Y + $50 - player_y) / 8, 20), table by X (< $A0, < $D0, else) and stage (dat_F932...dat_F9DA).

FA2E.name: task_move_enemy_shots
doc: Move the seven shots $0ECE-$0EDA: X + 2 or 3 by frame parity until $160 (then freed), Y by the signed 8.8 speed at $1B60+n; while $1114 runs flip their pictures.
Alias: proposed as task_move_bonus_objects.

FB09.name: task_refresh_formation_sprites
doc: When formation_sprites_dirty: refresh the 21 formation sprites $0E02-$0E2A from the flag pairs $1860-$1889 (size, shown/hidden).

FB58.name: task_show_188A_pair
doc: Show ($80) or hide the sprites $1E2D/$1E2F from the low bits of formation_flags+42/+43.

FB77.name: task_launch_group1
doc: Unless $112A/$10FE/$1013: count group1_timer; every 64th frame bump group1_count and go on through tbl_FBA8 (threshold word at U + 2B).
QUIRK: the index from group1_count is overwritten ($FB9F): the thresholds at U+2/U+4 are dead.

FBB3.name: launch_group1_tail
doc: When group1_timer reaches the word at U + 2B: restart it and launch the next free position of dat_FC09 (flag 2, path from $1052/$1054, or $DD44 with $1020).

FC6D.name: task_launch_group2
doc: The twin of task_launch_group1 for the second group ($10B5-$10B9, thresholds from $1042, tbl_FC9E).
QUIRK: the same dead index as task_launch_group1 ($FC95).

FCA9.name: launch_group2_tail
doc: As launch_group1_tail for the 18 positions of dat_FCFF (index $10B8), pointers $1056/$1058.
QUIRK: STB $084D ($FCE6) where launch_group1_tail does INC.

FD59.name: task_launch_trio
doc: Unless $112A/$10FE/$1013: count trio_timer and the free slots; at the threshold ($103A + 0-6) launch the 3 positions of the next group of dat_FDE9 (paths dat_FE19).
QUIRK: reads $188B but exits before testing it.

FE31.name: task_start_188A_object
doc: Every 64th frame count obj188A_count; at set counts (or with $10F8) start the object at formation_flags+42 if idle ($084E = sound trigger).

FE82.name: task_score_anim
doc: Once score_anim_step is non-zero, or when the scores are "round", show the next word of dat_F0C1 as sprite $0F12 moving by $0403; ends for good (score_anim_done) on the carry.
QUIRK: the first frame indexes dat_F0C1 with the score byte just compared ($FEBE).

B3F2.name: effect_sequence
doc: Effect 1: a sequence stepped by $10D0 once a frame: six sprites spread along the ship, switched on one by one, then moved; animates them with effect_animate.

B5A1.name: effect_rising
doc: Effect 0: six rising sprites at player_y - 8, picture lists dat_B653[$10D0]; $1069 counts to 480, which ends the effect.

B860.name: effect_setup
doc: Effects 2-5 (A = 2 * effect): one-shot set-ups: A = 6 formation speed $10 (and stage $1E/$2D extras), 8 $1114 = $32, 10 $1177 = 1, else the fighter upgrade (player_step 3, speed 1, shot speed + 1).

B92B.name: objects_task_end
doc: INC <sub_task / JMP task_dispatch_sub: tail of task_animate_objects, also object state 0 (only for a state byte of $80).
QUIRK: as object state 0 (state byte $80) it leaves the object loop with PSHS U and the BSR return on the stack.

B96B.name: obj_state2
doc: Object state 2: picture $4C07, next state. In: U sprite entry, Y state byte.

B973.name: obj_state3
doc: Object state 3: picture $4C06, next state.

B97B.name: obj_state4
doc: Object state 4: picture $4807, next state.

B983.name: obj_state5
doc: Object state 5: picture $5406, position + $0808 (one 16-bit add), flags $4080, next state.

B99D.name: obj_state6
doc: Object state 6: picture $5506, next state.

B9A5.name: obj_state7
doc: Object state 7: picture $5606, next state.

B9AD.name: obj_state8
doc: Object state 8: picture $5706, next state.

B9B5.name: obj_state9
doc: Object state 9: picture $500A, next state.

B9BD.name: obj_blink
doc: Object state 10: blink (code at $B9C5, shared with $BA3E); next state every 64th frame.

B9E2.name: obj_pick_side
doc: Object state 11: next state 12 if the object is above the player's row (Y < player_y), else 13.

B9F0.name: obj_move_down
doc: Object state 12: two steps down towards player_y, X + 3; explodes on reaching player_y or past X bit 8.

BA18.name: obj_move_up
doc: Object state 13: as state 12 but moving up, X + 2.

BA8E.name: obj_explode
doc: Object state 14: four fragments fly apart (picture dat_BB48[frame & 3]); cleared ($BB03) when the first leaves X/2 $50-$B7.

BD20.name: bonus_launch
doc: Bonus state 1: launch from $171E with path dat_BEAD[stage & 7], speed $28, state 2.

BD56.name: bonus_fly
doc: Bonus state 2: fly; off screen -> done (state 4); path ended -> back to the start point, count a pass ($1162/$1164), state 3, next path dat_BEBD/dat_BECD.

BE4F.name: bonus_hold
doc: Bonus state 3: hold at the start point $1109/$110B for U+$31B frames, then state 2.

BE6C.name: bonus_done
doc: Bonus state 4: bonus_free flag = 1.

E5AA.name: copy_slot42_flag

E5B8.name: task_slot42_timer

E729.name: capture_window
doc: When $10D6: every formation slot with b1 within the X window (<$D7..<$D8) and Y +-5 of the player is caught (b6, Y pinned to the player's).
QUIRK: the borrow of SUBB #$10 is lost at $E737.

E7FF.name: capture_state2
doc: Capture sub-state 2: window from $1693/$1E93, <$D8 three down (min $70); catch slots within Y +8/-7 of the player.

E8B0.name: capture_state0
doc: Capture sub-state 0: <$D8 = $1E93:$1693 >> 1 (see the BUG), next task.
BUG: stores A, not the halved B ($E8B8): always 0 when $1E93 is 0 or 1.

F6C7.name: bonus_seq_pick
doc: tbl_F62B[0]: sprite $0E86 = dat_F635[bonus_slots_used], bonus_anim_idx = 0.

F6D9.name: bonus_seq_fall
doc: tbl_F62B[1]: animate $0F2C through dat_F7AE (24 frames), move it down a pixel; at Y $158/$159 end the step.

F72C.name: bonus_seq_place
doc: tbl_F62B[2]: step $172C to dat_F7A5[n], then copy sprite $0F2C to slot dat_F7A8[n] and clear $1F2D.

F75D.name: bonus_seq_extend
doc: tbl_F62B[3]: all three of $1F27/$1F29/$1F2B set -> flag an extra reserve ship ($1F17..), sound $0855, a life; re-latch score_parity.
QUIRK: never tests slot $1F1F (the last one is taken unchecked).

F79D.name: bonus_seq_next
doc: tbl_F62B[4]: JMP $F6D4, only the next task.
